About.statement: I'm César León, a web developer with about three years building products for real clients.

paragraphs.work: I work from start to finish: I understand the business, propose the solution, build it and leave it running.
paragraphs.products: I build websites, online stores, admin panels, apps and chatbots.
paragraphs.way: I speak plainly, deliver in stages, and every step can be seen and tested.
